name: Ettin 150M
description: Larger Ettin encoder (Johns Hopkins, 149M parameters, 168 MB), same training as Ettin 68M. Held-out AUROC: 0.964 on rewritten AI texts, 0.933 on GPT-4 texts from unseen domains, 0.937 on the newest models (TextSight 2026), 0.803 on paraphrased GPT-4 texts, 0.765 on edited chatbot answers (Beemo). Calibrated: 50% flags 5% of human texts (MAGE).
